title: Vector Database Filtering Pre- vs. Post-Search: · Post-Filtering · Pre-Filtering
prompt: **Vector Database Filtering Pre- vs. Post-Search:** In an HNSW index, you want to find the top 10 nearest vectors where `category == "electronics"` and `price < 500`. Why does **Post-Filtering** (finding top 10 globally and filtering after) return zero results when the filter is selective (1% match), while **Pre-Filtering** breaks the HNSW graph connectivity? How does **Filtered HNSW / Acorn / Single-Stage Metadata-Aware Graph Traversal** solve this?
